kind: sampled manual inspection (not a complete scan); the automated contract and image checks cover every exported row
inspected_by: agent visual review of `python -m k2hv.data inspect` sheets (pilot and full): exact model-input images reconstructed from pixel_values, prompt and decoded supervised span

sft_cards.reviewed: 56 cards on contact sheets plus 6 model inputs at native resolution (2 DocVQA, 4 Nemotron COCO)
findings: VQAv2, TallyQA, TextVQA, Visual7W, VSR, CLEVR and AI2D labels were consistent with the visible image in every inspected card (e.g. plate '0011 fcg', 'since 1879', Casio watch, horse count 7).

DocVQA pages at the 1,024-image-token cap (784x1008 model input) remain legible at native resolution: typed form fields, letterheads and personnel lists read clearly; the payee 'Washington University' is visible.
CoSyn charts/tables are legible at ~1,000 image tokens; some answers are computed (averages, percentages) rather than read off the image; diagram answers are often vague relation words.
ChartVerse-SFT questions are multi-condition computations over dense multi-panel charts at the token cap; excluded.
OCR-VQA title labels include series text not on the cover and yes/no category questions come from store metadata; excluded.
Nemotron COCO counts follow COCO instance annotations: the person count (4) and 'toilets: 0' were verifiable; a 'cows: 3' item was not visible at model resolution.
ViRL39K prompts ended with a truncated 'Let's think step by step and' after the first format-stripping rule; fixed by removing the whole sentence that mentions the box, rerun before the full build.
One ViRL39K prompt has a literal '<image>/n'; normalized to a newline.
Geometry3K, ThinkLite and VisualWebInstruct references and canonical targets matched the source references (degrees and units removed: '65°' -> 65, '2 meters' -> 2).

Single-stage pHash+thumbnail matching flagged 233 pilot images; inspected pairs were mostly same-template charts (Statista bars/pies, TabMWP tables), US maps highlighting different states, and different pages of one UCSF document present in both DocVQA train and validation.

True duplicates: Nemotron COCO images pixel-identical to POPE images; Geometry3K and VisOnlyQA training images pixel-identical to MathVista testmini; ThinkLite images matching MathVista testmini and MMBench dev; a ThinkLite table recolored relative to an MMBench image; a VSR image in MathVista testmini.
The two-stage rule (aligned 256-px edge correlation and max 16x16-block RGB difference) was set from these pairs; it keeps every true duplicate above and rejects the templated look-alikes.
Question-text-only matches were all generic template questions on different images; they are listed and only excluded when long or when the images are loosely similar.

pixmo_count_hashes: 0 of 923 sampled URLs matched the supplied image_sha256 (raw bytes, decoded RGB, URL string and _o/_b/_k/_h/_c/_z size variants all tried on samples)

full_build.kind: sampled manual inspection of the full export (not a complete scan)
full_build.reviewed: 51 cards: 12 DocVQA/InfographicVQA/ST-VQA, 12 add-on (ChartQA, DVQA, IconQA, VisOnlyQA), 15 RL (3 per source), 12 AI2D/TextVQA/VSR/Nemotron
findings: DocVQA, InfographicVQA, ST-VQA, TextVQA, AI2D, ChartQA, DVQA and IconQA labels were consistent with the visible image where checkable (bus '10 MANCHESTER', plate 'ADSENSE', 5 squares -> E, Louisiana farthest west); some infographic numbers are not legible at contact-sheet scale.

RL targets matched source references; Geometry3K/ThinkLite keep spaced LaTeX ('\frac { 5 } { 7 }', '3 \sqrt { 2 }'), which the pinned math_dapo accepts against compact forms ('\frac{5}{7}', '\frac57', '3\sqrt2') because it strips spaces.

math_dapo is exact-string after normalization: '5/7', '\dfrac{5}{7}' and '5√3' are scored wrong against '\frac{5}{7}' and '5\sqrt{3}' targets; step 8 should account for this (prompt wording or an equivalence-aware selector).

Nemotron COCO spatial labels come from box geometry and can be ambiguous for held or overlapping objects (person 'below' the raised tennis racket, skateboard 'below' a person holding it at foot height).
ChartVerse-RL prompts are dense multi-panel charts at the 1,024-image-token cap; their numeric targets were not re-derived by hand.
